statement: Let n = len(heights). For 0 <= k < n, call k reachable if there exists a set S of indices i with 0 <= i < k and heights[i] < heights[i+1] such that |S| <= ladders and the sum, over all i with 0 <= i < k and heights[i] < heights[i+1] and i not in S, of (heights[i+1] - heights[i]) is at most bricks (empty sums are 0). The function returns a result r such that 0 <= r < n, r is reachable, and for every k with r < k < n, k is not reachable.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).

statement: The function returns a result r and 0 <= r < len(heights).
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).

statement: The function returns a result and does not fail for every heights, bricks, and ladders satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).
1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights); len(heights) = 1.

1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights); for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights)-1, heights[i] >= heights[i+1].

statement: Let n = len(heights). The function returns r where: if there exists j with 0 <= j < n-1 and heights[j] < heights[j+1], then r is the least such j; otherwise r = n-1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; bricks = 0; ladders = 0; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).

statement: Let n = len(heights). The function returns the largest r with 0 <= r < n such that the number of indices i satisfying 0 <= i < r and heights[i] < heights[i+1] is at most ladders.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; bricks = 0; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).

statement: Let n = len(heights). The function returns the largest r with 0 <= r < n such that the sum, over all i with 0 <= i < r and heights[i] < heights[i+1], of (heights[i+1] - heights[i]) is at most bricks (empty sums are 0).
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; ladders = 0; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).

statement: Let r1 be the result returned by furthest_building heights bricks1 ladders and let r2 be the result returned by furthest_building heights bricks2 ladders. Then r1 <= r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights); 0 <= bricks1 <= bricks2 <= 1000000000.

statement: Let r1 be the result returned by furthest_building heights bricks ladders1 and let r2 be the result returned by furthest_building heights bricks ladders2. Then r1 <= r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders1 <= ladders2 <= len(heights).

statement: If the function returns r, then there exists a set S of indices i with 0 <= i < r and heights[i] < heights[i+1] such that |S| <= ladders and the sum, over all i with 0 <= i < r and heights[i] < heights[i+1] and i not in S, of (heights[i+1] - heights[i]) is at most bricks (empty sums are 0).
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).

statement: If the function returns r and r < len(heights)-1, then building r+1 is not reachable; equivalently, for every set S of indices i with 0 <= i < r+1 and heights[i] < heights[i+1] such that |S| <= ladders, the sum, over all i with 0 <= i < r+1 and heights[i] < heights[i+1] and i not in S, of (heights[i+1] - heights[i]) is greater than bricks.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights).

statement: Let shifted be the slice of length len(heights) with shifted[i] = heights[i] + C for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights). If furthest_building heights bricks ladders returns r, then furthest_building shifted bricks ladders returns r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(heights) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] <= 1000000; 0 <= bricks <= 1000000000; 0 <= ladders <= len(heights); C is an integer such that for every i with 0 <= i < len(heights), 1 <= heights[i] + C <= 1000000.
